protocol.operation: Two disjoint transfers in one constituency, applied to the same baseline; full 29-constituency native allocation.

target.political_status: Researcher-fixed hypothetical roles; not a contemporary support agreement.

protocol.cost: Within-constituency half-L1; equal to a+b for the four disjoint directions.
protocol.interaction: f(a,b)-f(a,0)-f(0,b)+f(0,0), separately for seat counts and threshold indicators.
protocol.mask: All four corners must be valid; insufficient supply, changed eligibility, ties and unsupported computations are typed null.
protocol.reporting: Every pair, constituency and amount combination retained; equal-cost witnesses selected in source order at every sampled total cost.
protocol.beneficiary_unit: Unique nonzero native input table, not tensor coordinate; gains at recipient and nonrecipient parties reported separately.
protocol.interpretation: Retrospective exact counterfactual experiment; no probabilistic support model, empirical voter-flow estimate or global minimum claim.
